definition: BML-7D is the Taiji 7D Bagua Metric Language: Two-Polarity Fields (Liangyi) + Eight-Formation routing grammar (Bagua) + Five-Metric prefix = seven runtime dimensions.

rules: 7D is 5D_PREFIX elevated by Liangyi fields [heaven, earth].
Bagua is formation opcode and routing grammar, not an additional dimension.
Every packet, event, memory, authorization, Odoo projection, AI derivation, geospatial node, and audit record MUST map to 7D_CODE.
Raw plaintext context MUST NOT be used as the canonical transferable unit.

H001.name: modify_5d_prefix
H001.condition: packet attempts to rename, remove, reorder, or overwrite [x,y,z,time,scale]

H002.name: cloud_direct_write_real_state
H002.condition: cloud_ai attempts direct write to Odoo, database, device, policy, or runtime state

H004.name: raw_identity_to_cloud
H004.condition: raw identity, raw LINE ID, member record, private personal data routed to cloud

H005.name: odoo_direct_mutation_without_metric_gate
H005.condition: Odoo write occurs without metric_gate and audit metadata

H006.name: policy_unlocked_mutation
H006.condition: policy modification without checkpoint, impact analysis, rollback, and audit

H007.name: raw_plaintext_as_canonical_unit
H007.condition: raw plaintext context is used as canonical transferable unit

geospatial_topology.scope: 新北市三重區五常里、五順里、仁忠里
geospatial_topology.private_member_location_rule: private or member-level geospatial joins require minimization, masking, authorization window, and audit before any projection.

dimension_model.formula: 2_POLARITY_FIELDS + 5_METRIC_PREFIX = 7D; BAGUA is formation opcode/route grammar, not an extra dimension.
dimension_model.zh_formula: 兩儀 + 五維度規 = 七維；八陣是 formation opcode / route grammar，不是第八維。
rules: heaven is the governance/policy/authority polarity field.
earth is the local substrate/execution/state polarity field.
Bagua formations classify packet route, risk gate, audit window, and payload behavior.
Bagua formations do not add or remove dimensions from 7D_CODE.
